The Max Planck Society is Germany's premier research organization. The 86 Max Planck Institutes conduct research at highest levels, in the service of the general public, in the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences, and the humanities.The Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD) is located at the Science Campus Hamburg-Bahrenfeld and investigates dynamical phenomena within matter down to the elementary timescales of atomic and electronic motions, the femtosecond or attosecond timescale. The focus is on the use of short wavelength ultrafast probes, such as X-rays or electron pulses, which are capable of measuring atomic and electronic structures in matter of all kinds.The MPSD currently consists of five scientific departments focusing on solid state physics and theoretical methods in these fields. The MPSD is a partner in the Center for Free-Electron Laser Science (CFEL), collaborating with the Deutsches Elektronen Synchrotron (DESY), European XFEL (EuXFEL) and the University of Hamburg in the development of science based on the X-ray Free Electron Lasers (XFELs).To strengthen our support for experimental research, the MPSD is seeking a highly motivatedElectronics Engineer (m/f/d)Your positionAs an Electronics Engineer, you will support cutting-edge experimental physics research by developing reliable, high-performance electronic systems in close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff.- Develop, design and implement analogue and digital electronic systems for experimental physics applications.- Translate scientific and technical requirements into robust electronic concepts, circuits and complete devices.- Design, assemble, commission and test printed circuit boards (PCBs) and electronic instruments, from initial concept through prototyping to deployment in the laboratory.- Diagnose, troubleshoot and optimise existing electronic systems and measurement equipment.- Develop firmware for microcontrollers and support the integration of hardware, firmware and software components.- Work closely with researchers and engineers to provide practical, user-oriented technical solutions for a broad range of experimental setups.- Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including circuit diagrams, PCB layouts, assembly instructions and test procedures.- As the role involves hands-on development, assembly, testing and support of laboratory equipment, regular on-site presence is an essential part of the position.Your background and skills- A university degree (Master’s degree or Diplom) in electrical engineering, electronics or a closely related field.- Sound practical experience in the development of analogue and digital electronic systems, including circuit design, PCB layout and the assembly, commissioning and testing of electronic devices.- Proficiency in common ECAD tools for schematic capture and PCB design, ideally including KiCad or Autodesk EAGLE, as well as familiarity with circuit-simulation tools.- Knowledge of firmware development for microcontrollers, ideally using C/C++. Experience in developing user software for the control, operation and monitoring of electronic devices is also desirable.- Experience with FPGA development and VHDL is an advantage. Familiarity with CAD systems for mechanical design is also desirable.- A strong understanding of the requirements and working practices of a diverse scientific and technical environment, combined with intercultural competence and effective communication skills.- Excellent written and spoken German and English skills.- Experience in laboratory electronics, measurement technology, scientific instrumentation or experimental physics is desirable.Our offer- A varied and responsible position in an international and interdisciplinary scientific environment, with the opportunity to contribute directly to innovative experimental research.- Close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff on challenging and diverse technical projects.- A family-friendly working environment with flexible working arrangements, in line with the practical requirements of laboratory-based work.- Opportunities for professional development and further training.- Attractive remuneration and social benefits in accordance with the applicable public-sector collective agreement, depending on qualifications and professional experience.- An initial contract for two years, with the possibility of permanent employment thereafter.- The opportunity to work in a collaborative, inclusive and forward-looking research environment.- A subsidy for the Profiticket as a Germany ticketYour applicationThe Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. You will shape the frameworks, processes, systems and capabilities that enable our sales teams to perform at their best — while ensuring that SUSONITY captures the full value of its innovative products and solutions.You will act as the global catalyst for stronger pricing discipline, better commercial decision-making and consistently excellent execution across regions and markets. Your impactLead the global pricing agendaPricing will be one of your most important areas of responsibility. You will establish pricing as a strategic capability across SUSONITY by:- Developing and implementing a global pricing strategy aligned with business objectives, customer value and market dynamics.- Establishing pricing governance, principles, processes and approval frameworks across regions and businesses.- Driving value-based pricing, price differentiation and improved price realization.- Strengthening transparency and consistency in pricing decisions through robust data, analytics and performance management.- Partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Finance and regional leadership to embed pricing excellence into day-to-day commercial decisions.- Identifying opportunities to improve margins, commercial effectiveness and sustainable profitable growth.- Enhancing the use of pricing software and digital tools to enable fact-based, timely and scalable pricing decisions.Build and lead commercial excellenceBeyond pricing, you will lead the continued development of SUSONITY’s global commercial excellence platform:- Define and implement a global commercial excellence strategy that improves sales force effectiveness and delivers measurable business impact.- Optimize commercial infrastructure, including customer segmentation, lead management, opportunity tracking and campaign performance.- Establish meaningful KPIs, dashboards and performance routines that turn data into actionable commercial insight.- Drive the effective use and continuous improvement of Salesforce, pricing software and other commercial technologies.- Develop standardized frameworks, processes and tools that create alignment while allowing for relevant regional flexibility.- Strengthen launch excellence for new products and campaigns in close collaboration with Marketing, Product Management and regional teams.- Support post-merger integration by helping build a unified, scalable and high-performing commercial operating model.Lead people, influence globally and raise ambitionYou will lead a team of tool and process experts while orchestrating a broad global network of stakeholders across Commercial, Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Finance and other functions. Your role will be to create clarity, build momentum and turn strategic priorities into practical execution. You will challenge established ways of working, build strong partnerships and ensure that commercial excellence becomes a shared capability across the organization. What you bring- A university degree in Business Administration, Commercial Management, Sales, Finance or a related discipline.- Significant experience in commercial excellence, pricing, sales operations, commercial strategy or a comparable leadership function, ideally within a B2B or chemical industry environment.- Demonstrated success in developing and implementing pricing strategies, pricing governance, value-based pricing or commercial performance initiatives.- Strong understanding of the connection between pricing, customer value, sales effectiveness and profitable growth.- Experience leading teams, cross-functional programs and global stakeholder networks.- Strong command of CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, as well as pricing software and commercial analytics tools.- Excellent analytical and conceptual capabilities, combined with the ability to translate insights into clear decisions and practical action.- Proven project and change management skills, with the ability to lead complex initiatives in a fast-moving, international environment.- Exceptional communication, influencing and negotiation skills, including the confidence to engage with senior stakeholders.- A pragmatic, entrepreneurial and collaborative leadership style.- Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage. Why join SUSONITY?This is an opportunity to shape a function that is strategically critical to SUSONITY’s future.You will have the mandate and visibility to build global pricing and commercial excellence capabilities from the ground up, influence how we go to market and help ensure that the value of our innovations is reflected in every commercial decision.At SUSONITY, you will work in a culture that combines scientific expertise, creative exploration and entrepreneurial drive. We empower our people to take ownership, challenge conventions and create meaningful impact across markets and industries.If you are ready to make pricing a true source of competitive advantage and to help build the commercial foundation of a fast-evolving global organization, we look forward to hearing from you.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
